title: Luscious Thai-Bird-Chili Chinese Fish Steamed
description: A pescatarian-friendly Chinese steamed dish featuring Thai-bird-chili, agemono-deep-fry, and a bamboo-tray vessel. This dish is perfect for a sick day with its jammy and aerated texture.
instructions: Mix fish fillets with Thai bird chili peppers, ginger, soy sauce, and sugar in a bowl.
Prepare the bamboo steamer tray by placing scallions in the bottom.
Add the fish mixture to the steamer tray, leaving space for air to circulate.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Heat a pot of water to a boil and place the bamboo steamer tray on top.
Steam for 10 minutes or until the fish is cooked through.
Serve hot with a side of cornstarch slurry, which should be mixed with water to a desired consistency.
Garnish with additional scallions if desired.
